offers_products.reason: Supplies CPAP devices, masks, wheelchairs, hospital beds, ostomy and wound supplies, and oxygen equipment to patients.

offers_services.reason: Home delivery, oxygen therapy, equipment setup, respiratory care, insurance billing and clinician support are core home medical equipment services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Patients at home choose and receive CPAP, oxygen, mobility and ostomy supplies, though insurers pay.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Buyers are individual patients; insurers and Medicare pay, but physicians and patients choose. Organizations are payers, not buyers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Recurring resupply of CPAP, ostomy, and wound supplies plus monthly oxygen and equipment rentals drive most revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Prescribed medical needs such as oxygen, CPAP, ostomy and wound care are non-discretionary and insurance-covered.

big_ticket.reason: Mostly small frequent resupply orders and monthly rentals, covered by insurance, rather than large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes mainly from supplying equipment and supplies via a distribution network, not from staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are individual patients at home, though Medicare and insurers pay.

asset_heavy.reason: Needs rental equipment fleets such as oxygen concentrators and hospital beds, plus delivery vehicles and many branch locations.

notes: Diabetes business is being divested to Cardinal Health. Payers are mostly insurers and Medicare.
